script.script:
Look, I get why Botox and more creams are tempting when you see those lines around your eyes every morning.

But that's a needle in one of the most delicate spots on your face. It's expensive, it hurts, you're back every three months, and there's always the risk of that frozen, droopy look you're stuck with for months.

So if you want smoother-looking eyes without needles, and without more expensive creams, there's an easier way. Castor oil. Women have used it for centuries.

Haven and Spool is one ingredient: organic, cold-pressed castor oil that soaks in and holds moisture around your eyes all night, without feeling greasy or heavy. The rose quartz roller stays cool on your skin and puts on just a thin layer. Two minutes before bed.

And you won't feel like hiding behind concealer or sunglasses anymore.

Just look at what it's done for these women. It's buy one, get one free right now, and 30 nights or your money back. Click below.

editing_notes: Replicate this format: Reference (link above). Open exactly like the reference: a real-looking close-up of a gloved injector putting a needle next to a woman's eye, text hook on screen. Then VO over a B-roll montage: women at the mirror looking at their eye lines, an injector in a clinic, a price/receipt, a calendar every 3 months, then the switch to castor oil (castor plant, the amber bottle, women rolling it under their eyes). About 55 to 65 seconds (the reference is 49). Small white captions like the reference. Where the reference shows a Before / After split, use a 10PM / 7AM split (rolling it on at night vs fresh in the morning) or real customer photos only: no AI before/afters. Keep the Botox part to cost, needles, upkeep and the frozen look: no medical scare claims (nerve damage, blindness). B-roll (UGC & AI): needle near the eye, woman at the mirror, injector, receipt, calendar, castor plant, roller under the eye macro, women smiling, bottle held up.

Voiceover: Average American female, 40s to 50s, calm and caring, like a friend talking you out of something: serious on the Botox part, warm and relieved on the castor oil part. NEEDS TO HAVE CONVICTION in their voice, its boring to listen to a dull script. They need to speak with character.

Avatar: Voiceover + B-roll like the reference, no main creator. B-roll women are real-looking, 45 to 65: one getting a Botox injection near her eye (opening shot), women looking at the lines around their eyes in the mirror, then women rolling Haven & Spool under their eyes and smiling. Problem aware to product aware: she has eye wrinkles, has thought about Botox, and is looking for an easier way.
